;International relations
*[[Israel–Jordan relations]]
**[[Abdullah II of Jordan|King Abdullah II]] announces [[Jordan]] will reclaim two small plots of farmland territory leased to [[Israel]] under their [[Israel–Jordan peace treaty| 1994 peace treaty]].
